# terrakube_workspace_tag (Data Source)

Query a tag attached to a Terrakube workspace by the tag name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "simple"
}

data "terrakube_workspace" "ws" {
  name         = "myworkspace"
  organization = "simple"
}

data "terrakube_workspace_tag" "example" {
  name            = "mytag"
  workspace_id    = data.terrakube_workspace.ws.id
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tag
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization id
- `workspace_id` (String) Terrakube workspace id

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Workspace Tag Id
- `tag_id` (String) Organization Tag Id
- `value` (String) Value of a key/value tag. Null for a key-only tag or when the Terrakube version does not support tag values.
